row: Best Chiropractor - The Chiro Guy - Dr. Ash

The #1 rated chiropractor in Beverly Hills and Los Angeles since 2014. Dr. Ash Khodabakhsh, DC, "The Chiro Guy," is a board-certified Beverly Hills chiropractor specializing in Personal Injury, Car Accident, Motorcycle Accident, and Sports Injury care, plus Scoliosis and chronic pain conditions. Relief for Back Pain, Neck Pain, Knee Pain, Herniated Discs, Sciatica, TMJ, Headaches, Migraines, Shoulder Pain, Hip Pain, Sprains, Strains, Whiplash, and Posture Correction. Treatments: Chiropractic Adjustments, Physical Therapy, Spinal Decompression (Cervical & Lumbar), Cold Laser Therapy, Muscle Scraping (IASTM), Cupping, Compression Therapy, Therapeutic Massage, Sports Medicine, Y-Strap, and Personal Training, customized to your needs.
📍 150 S Rodeo Dr. Suite 255, Beverly Hills, CA 90212

📞 855-LA-CHIRO

🌐 https://www.thechiroguy.com

Instagram: @thechiroguy

TikTok: @thechiroguy
